name: echo-behavior-lab
description: Multi-tenant black-box API behavior experiments and release regression checks

scripts.build: npm run db:generate && npm run build -w @echo/api && npm run build -w @echo/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @echo/api && npm run test -w @echo/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @echo/api && npm run typecheck -w @echo/web
